card.name: Small linking words mid-clause
card.fires_on: Short linking words (can, during, for, by, and, to, of) in the middle of a clause, just before a key event or condition term. Seen in label instructions about therapy periods, overdose and missed doses.

modes.label: Time-span links
modes.description: Words like during, for or and linking therapy to a time period afterward.
modes.example: Blood Donation: Avoid during therapy and<< for>> 6 weeks thereafter.

modes.label: Links before overdose or missed events
modes.description: The words of, by or to just before overdose, ingestion or a missed injection.
modes.example: in order to reduce the risk<< of>> overdose Screening Patients for Bipolar Disorder

modes.description: A modal or preposition in a general statement outside drug labels.
